Hi Helen —

Appreciate the CAIQ and the SOC 2 summary. Short answer: Vendr is our preferred portal for profiles right now (we sync to OneTrust for procurement). We can accept the CAIQ export as a first pass. For a stage-1 assessment we typically need:

- Unredacted SOC 2 cover page + auditor op/attestation (or an authorized SOC 2 summary letter)
- CAIQ export (you already sent the partial)
- Evidence linking the SOC 2 controls to artifacts (e.g., KMS key rotation policy, patch runbook PDFs, IAM role attestations)
- A contact for SSO/SCIM setup (if you want automatic profile updates)

Can Monica and Priyom help run a quick lint of the CAIQ and produce a gaplist we can share internally? Once we have that, we will create the Vendr invite and share the SSO metadata. If you need a temporary upload window we can provide presigned S3.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Monday 2027-12-13 at 10:00 PT to review the gaplist and SSO requirements. Does that work on your side?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick internal note and checklist for the gaplist:

1) CAIQ lint items I already see (will attach an export after I run the tool): missing evidence pointers for A.12 (devops patching), A.14 (third-party subprocessing), SC-13 (KMS rotation logs).
2) SOC 2: need either the full auditor report under NDA or an SOC attestation letter that references the testing period (we can accept under an NDA).
3) Artifacts we can accept initially: KMS key policy JSON (redacted ARNs ok), patch runbook PDF, vulnerability scan summary from the last 30 days, and a short architecture diagram (png).
4) For Vendr SSO we need the IdP metadata XML or an SP-initiated URL and an admin email for SCIM invites.

I'll run the CAIQ through our parser and drop a gaplist (spreadsheet) into the Drive link Karthik mentioned. Attaching our onboarding checklist for clarity.

Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

—Monica
